questiontext.text:
Vital statistics form perhaps the most important branch of statistics as they deal with mankind in the aggregate.

Which among the following is NOT a vital statistic? Select all that apply:

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

[[ if test="member(1, ta_index)" ]]

Warfare rate - This is not a vital statistic. Vital statistics typically focus on events related to births, deaths, marriages, and divorces, while the warfare rate is more related to conflicts and military activities.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(2, ta_index)" ]]

Elegance rate - This is not a recognized vital statistic. "Elegance rate" seems to be a term that is not commonly used in the context of vital statistics.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(3, ta_index)" ]]

Sleeping rate - This is not a vital statistic. "Sleeping rate" does not typically refer to a demographic or vital event and seems to be an unrelated concept.

[[/ if ]] [[ if test="member(4, ta_index)" ]]

Data collection: This is not a vital statistic - "Data collection" is a process, not a vital statistic. Vital statistics are specific numerical measures related to vital events in a population.

[[/ if ]]
